title: Hogan and Mr. T vs. Piper and Orndorff
summary: Roddy Piper’s hostility to Hogan and his celebrity allies builds into the first WrestleMania main event. The rivalry joins championship wrestling to the Rock ’n’ Wrestling boom.

chapters.title: The war spills beyond the title match
chapters.show: The War to Settle the Score
chapters.context: The confrontation is a key stop on the road to the WrestleMania tag match.

chapters.title: The first WrestleMania main event
chapters.result: Hogan and Mr. T defeat Piper and Paul Orndorff.
chapters.context: The celebrity partnership wins the show’s main event.
